_comment: niu-notify routing. Copy to discord.json (gitignored; bin/install --notify does it). Webhook URLs never go here: routes name environment variables, which you set in the workspace secrets file (names in .env.example).
_endpoints: Keys are the endpoint names from ollama.json. notify: on | silent | off. Set an endpoint that is not always on to silent (with a larger down_after_polls) or off. display overrides the label shown in Discord.
